definitions.explanation: A name used to conceal one's true identity. Often implies deceptive intent, unlike pen names or stage names which are openly acknowledged.

examples.japanese: {偽名|ぎめい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦ホテル→ホテル：01027_hoteru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{泊|と}まった→泊まる：10445_tomaru⟧。
examples.english: He stayed at the hotel under a false name.

examples.japanese: ⟦{犯人|はんにん}→犯人：03572_hannin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{偽名|ぎめい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}って→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦{逃|に}げていた→逃げる：01151_nigeru⟧。
examples.english: The criminal had been on the run using a false name.

examples.japanese: {偽名|ぎめい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{契約|けいやく}を{結|むす}ぶ→契約を結ぶ：18695_keiyakuwomusubu⟧こと⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{法律|ほうりつ}→法律：01722_houritsu⟧⟦{違反|いはん}→違反：01824_ihan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦{場合|ばあい}→場合：01704_baai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Entering a contract under a false name can be a legal violation.

notes:
USAGE:
Carries a negative nuance implying deception. Used in news, crime reports, and fiction. For non-deceptive alternative names, Japanese uses different terms.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {偽名|ぎめい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧ (to use a false name)
- {偽名|ぎめい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧～⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to do something under a false name)
- {偽名|ぎめい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{名乗|なの}る→名乗る：11874_nanoru⟧ (to go by a false name)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{芸名|げいめい}→芸名：25284_geimei⟧: stage name — used openly by entertainers, no deceptive intent
- ⟦ペンネーム→ペンネーム：25452_penneemu⟧: pen name — used openly by writers
- {仮名|かめい}: pseudonym; alias — more neutral, used in news to protect identity
